hypotheses.text: pH-sensitive Fcabs can be isolated without histidine mutations, at least in the three Fcabs described.
hypotheses.rationale: PMC4314675 excerpt notes two of three isolated pH-sensitive Fcabs lacked histidine mutations, but the excerpt is an abstract fragment only with no pH-dependence data, mechanism, or generalizability information, so functional pH sensitivity and broader applicability remain unverified.
